coupons_usage_limits_positive.name: coupons_usage_limits_positive
coupons_usage_limits_positive.value:
("coupons"."usage_limit" IS NULL OR "coupons"."usage_limit" > 0)
      AND ("coupons"."usage_limit_per_customer" IS NULL OR "coupons"."usage_limit_per_customer" > 0)

coupons_date_range_valid.name: coupons_date_range_valid
coupons_date_range_valid.value: "coupons"."end_at" IS NULL OR "coupons"."start_at" IS NULL OR "coupons"."end_at" >= "coupons"."start_at"

notifications_event_user_unique.name: notifications_event_user_unique
notifications_event_user_unique.where: "notifications"."event_key" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."company_id" IS NULL

notifications_event_company_unique.name: notifications_event_company_unique
notifications_event_company_unique.where: "notifications"."event_key" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."company_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."user_id" IS NULL

notifications_event_user_company_unique.name: notifications_event_user_company_unique
notifications_event_user_company_unique.where: "notifications"."event_key" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."company_id" IS NOT NULL

payment_recovery_jobs_payment_operation_.name: payment_recovery_jobs_payment_operation_active_unique
payment_recovery_jobs_payment_operation_.where: "payment_recovery_jobs"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_recovery_jobs"."operation" NOT IN ('webhook', 'refund') AND "payment_recovery_jobs"."status" IN ('pending', 'processing', 'failed')

payment_recovery_jobs_refund_operation_a.name: payment_recovery_jobs_refund_operation_active_unique
payment_recovery_jobs_refund_operation_a.where: "payment_recovery_jobs"."refund_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_recovery_jobs"."operation" = 'refund' AND "payment_recovery_jobs"."status" IN ('pending', 'processing', 'failed')

products_featured_public_homepage_idx.name: products_featured_public_homepage_idx
products_featured_public_homepage_idx.where: "products"."featured" = true AND "products"."status" = 'active' AND "products"."published_at" IS NOT NULL

products_homepage_wholesale_public_idx.name: products_homepage_wholesale_public_idx
products_homepage_wholesale_public_idx.where: "products"."homepage_wholesale" = true AND "products"."status" = 'active' AND "products"."published_at" IS NOT NULL

products_dimensions_nonnegative.name: products_dimensions_nonnegative
products_dimensions_nonnegative.value:
("products"."width" IS NULL OR "products"."width" >= 0)
      AND ("products"."height" IS NULL OR "products"."height" >= 0)
      AND ("products"."length" IS NULL OR "products"."length" >= 0)

promotion_campaigns_usage_limits_positiv.name: promotion_campaigns_usage_limits_positive
promotion_campaigns_usage_limits_positiv.value: ("promotion_campaigns"."usage_limit" IS NULL OR "promotion_campaigns"."usage_limit" > 0) AND ("promotion_campaigns"."usage_limit_per_customer" IS NULL OR "promotion_campaigns"."usage_limit_per_customer" > 0)

shipping_rules_values_nonnegative.name: shipping_rules_values_nonnegative
shipping_rules_values_nonnegative.value:
("shipping_rules"."minimum_order_value" IS NULL OR "shipping_rules"."minimum_order_value" >= 0)
      AND ("shipping_rules"."maximum_order_value" IS NULL OR "shipping_rules"."maximum_order_value" >= 0)
      AND "shipping_rules"."shipping_price" >= 0
      AND ("shipping_rules"."minimum_weight" IS NULL OR "shipping_rules"."minimum_weight" >= 0)
      AND ("shipping_rules"."maximum_weight" IS NULL OR "shipping_rules"."maximum_weight" >= 0)

shipping_rules_ranges_valid.name: shipping_rules_ranges_valid
shipping_rules_ranges_valid.value:
("shipping_rules"."maximum_order_value" IS NULL OR "shipping_rules"."minimum_order_value" IS NULL OR "shipping_rules"."maximum_order_value" >= "shipping_rules"."minimum_order_value")
      AND ("shipping_rules"."maximum_weight" IS NULL OR "shipping_rules"."minimum_weight" IS NULL OR "shipping_rules"."maximum_weight" >= "shipping_rules"."minimum_weight")
